description: This file contains CSS styles for the App component of a Tic Tac Toe interactive game, managing both light and dark themes using CSS variables and defining styles for various elements such as headers and buttons.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main stylesheet for the App component that centers its content, manages background colors based on theme, and applies animations to the logo.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the theme toggle button including positioning, background color, and hover effects.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Styles for the header of the App, ensuring it displays flexibly and aligns its items centrally.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Styles for the App logo, including size and animation when reduced motion is not preferred.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styles for application links, including color transitions.
